title: Wolf and Veil
author: Orsen Sterling
blurb: Bram Hartwell, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
